_schema: KJV → Hebrew (OSHB) versification mapping for books where they diverge. Uniform-offset psalms and chapter-renumber books are handled; books with complex chapter-boundary shifts (Num, 1Sam, 1Kgs, 1Chr, Neh, Isa) are listed as `skipped_books` and will be added in a follow-up phase using authoritative per-verse mappings.
_source_notes: Psalms offsets derived algorithmically from verse-count differences between KJV and OSHB (Phase 2C-6). Joel and Malachi chapter mappings are sourced from standard versification tables (e.g. BDB, BHS introductions — widely documented textual-tradition divergence).

psalms_offsets._doc: For each KJV Psalms chapter with a superscription in the Hebrew, add offset to the KJV verse number to get the Hebrew verse. E.g. offset=1 means KJV Ps 3:1 → Heb Ps 3:2.

joel_mapping._doc: KJV Joel has 3 chapters; Hebrew has 4. KJV 2:28-32 = Heb 3:1-5 (new chapter); KJV 3:1-21 = Heb 4:1-21.

malachi_mapping._doc: KJV Malachi has 4 chapters; Hebrew has 3. KJV 4:1-6 = Heb 3:19-24. Chapters 1-3 align verse-for-verse.

skipped_books._doc: Books whose KJV → Hebrew mapping involves chapter-boundary shifts of more than ±1 verse, requiring authoritative per-verse mappings. Deferred to a follow-up phase. Current KJV text for these books is NOT ingested; verse pages for these books will show only the Hebrew original until the mapping is completed.
skipped_books.NUM: Ch 16/17 split differs by 15 verses (Heb 16:1-35 = KJV 16:1-35; KJV 16:36-50 = Heb 17:1-15); plus ±1 shifts at 25:19, 29:40, 30:1.
skipped_books.1SA: Chapter boundaries at 21/22 and 23/24 differ by ±1 verse.
skipped_books.1KI: Ch 4/5 boundary differs by 14 verses; plus 22:43/44.
skipped_books.1CH: Ch 5/6 boundary differs by 15 verses; plus 12:40/41.
skipped_books.NEH: Ch 3/4 boundary differs by 6 verses; plus ±1 at 7:68, 9:38, 10:1.
skipped_books.ISA: Ch 8/9 boundary differs by 1 verse; plus 63:19/64:1.
